  @doc """
  Polls a rendered LiveView until `matcher` accepts the HTML, or fails.

  The landing page's countdown is a real `Process.send_after` at a five
  second interval that is deliberately identical in `:test` (see

  bounded so a regression fails instead of hanging.
  """

    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + timeout_ms
    do_await(view, matcher, deadline)
  end

    html = render(view)
    cond do
      matcher.(html) -> html
      System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) >= deadline ->
        flunk("timed out waiting for the LiveView to render a matching state (waited the full countdown interval)")
      true -> Process.sleep(100); do_await(view, matcher, deadline)
    end
  end
end
